description: A signed read that only the subscriber wallet itself can make: given that wallet, returns its paid months, each window's program budget, the asset naming on record, and fulfillment state. To read, call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, sign it with that wallet (personal_sign, free, no gas), then call again with the wallet, the nonce and the signature within 5 minutes: a signature is good for one read, and a request without a valid one is refused the same way for every wallet. Everything the program does for the wallet — the mint, the burned market seed, every standing buy — is independently checkable on Base. Free, read-only. Cost and signer: free; a list by wallet is signed by that wallet itself with no gas, and the house never holds a key.

nonce.description: With wallet: the time in milliseconds the read is signed at, within 5 minutes of the board's time. The first answer gives you one; pass the same number back with the signature.

signature.description: With wallet and nonce: the 0x… personal_sign output over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN, made by that same wallet. Good for one read.

wallet.description: The subscriber wallet (0x…), the same wallet that paid. Address only, never a private key. Reading it is a signed read: call with the wallet alone to get MESSAGE_TO_SIGN.

name: net_subscription_status
title: A wallet's program subscription: months paid and program state (a signed read)
